name: beam
subtitle: beam remote desktop for iPhone and iPad

apps.name: beam
apps.subtitle: Your Mac's screen, with low latency
apps.localizedDescription: The iPhone and iPad viewer for beam: hardware video decoding, sound, trackpad-style touch and a key bar, end-to-end encrypted to your Mac.

privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: beam connects to your Mac when it is on the same network.

versions.localizedDescription:
- iOS: release.sh publishes to a SideStore source (jasfertoh/beam-releases)
- Disconnect button, Mac switcher, and ending sessions from beam's menu
- Frame acks: see backlog in the kernel send buffer, not just our own queue
- Keep remembered devices across restarts: forget a token only on 4007/4008
- Clipboard: images both ways, as PNG
- Touch: coasting two-finger scroll, three-finger swipes (⌃ + arrow) and tap (middle-click)
- Key bar: del, home, end, page up/down and F1–F12; the row scrolls, paste and hide stay pinned
- Two-finger scroll: decide scroll or pinch once per gesture
- Move beam's own port from 8787 to 8790
- iOS: password-sheet banner and display picker; BEAM_DIR for test engines
- iOS app: cursor drawn on the device, clipboard both ways, file transfer
- iOS: example address no longer shows the home IP
- Home-network path beside the tunnel, Auto resolution, cursor kept in fullscreen
- End-to-end encryption for the iOS app; HSTS behind the tunnel
- Cloudflare Access: beam verifies the Access token; iOS sends a service token
- Cloudflare named tunnel: Beam.app tunnel mode, iOS system trust for real certificates
- Input fixes: 'a' no longer sticks, Caps Lock toggles the Mac's lock, games get relative mouse
- Native iPhone/iPad viewer: pinned TLS WebSocket, hardware decode to AVSampleBufferDisplayLayer, Opus audio, trackpad-style touch, key bar and hardware keyboard; host labels it in the device list
